title: Chapter 2654 - 71: Mystic Fire Feather Robe (2)
content:
Chapter 2654: Chapter 71: Mystic Fire Feather Robe (2)

This also led to the Shugu Tribe, in a "divergent" state, occupying a considerable part.

They wander around, burning, looting, committing all sorts of atrocities.

Among these wandering tribes, though not entirely without good, the vast majority are not good people.

This time, the crimes committed by this wandering Shugu Tribe were even worse than before.

Dan Zhu began arranging manpower to carry out a siege.

He is the Young Master of the Danque Tribe, and although he hasn’t experienced actual combat, he has learned the basics of battling barbarian soldiers.

With Elders Ba Shan and Bachuan giving advice by the side, and the seasoned Danque Tribe vanguard Barbarian General Chi Feng overseeing, planning to ambush and completely wipe out this group of Shugu Wanderers midway up the mountain in the forest posed no major issue.

This band of Shugu Wanderers, numbering about eighty to ninety people, is most likely led by someone at the Golden Core stage.

However, the Danque Tribe is evidently stronger, and with the advantage of surprise, their superiority is even greater.

Mo Hua glanced at the overall battle map and found no issues with it either.

Dan Zhu is a genius, and Chi Feng a veteran; even if Mo Hua were to plan it, it could only be arranged this way.

Mo Hua pondered for a moment and then said to Dan Zhu:

"Young Master, you lead the charge."

Dan Zhu was naturally willing.

But Elders Ba Shan and Bachuan quickly said:

"Young Master, such petty scoundrels like Shugu aren’t worth you personally taking action. You should oversee the big picture and hold the fort in the rear."

The two of them, as the guard elders of Dan Zhu, were afraid that during the war, Dan Zhu might suffer the slightest misfortune.

Although, with Dan Zhu’s prowess, there usually wouldn’t be much risk.

But better safe than sorry.

Dan Zhu is invaluable; if he were to genuinely encounter any unexpected incidents, as his guard elders, there wouldn’t be enough deaths to atone for it.

Dan Zhu naturally wished to personally charge and kill the enemy.

Yet he was also very considerate of the elders Ba Shan and Bachuan’s concerns and difficulty.

Dan Zhu then looked at Mo Hua.

Seeing this, Elders Ba Shan and Bachuan felt bitter, thinking of a good Young Master who would refer to this fair-skinned flatterer whenever faced with a decision.

As expected, Mo Hua said, "Rest assured and fight; there will be no danger this time."

Dan Zhu nodded and said, "Alright, gentleman."

Ba Shan and Bachuan were infuriated.

Elder Ba Shan still tried hard to persuade: "Young Master, as it concerns your safety, you must not easily believe..."

But before he could finish, Dan Zhu, already "bewitched" by Mo Hua, interrupted:

"No need to say more, my mind is made up."

Elder Ba Shan could only sigh deeply.

Afterwards, Dan Zhu began "deploying troops and arranging formations", dividing the hundred elite barbarian soldiers of the Danque Tribe into three routes.

Elders Ba Shan and Bachuan each led over thirty men to encircle from the other two sides.

Dan Zhu and Chi Feng then led the remaining soldiers to charge from the front.

They would then launch a three-sided attack to completely annihilate this Shugu Wandering Tribe. Capture if possible, kill if not.

Being a "Shaman", Mo Hua, being physically frail and only at Foundation Establishment, had no combat ability and thus need not lead the charge, only watching from the side.

This was also unanimously agreed by the Danque Tribe.

After all, Mo Hua was indeed "frail".

After the plan was set, the Danque Tribe’s soldiers began to act separately.

In the dark night, a subtle murderous aura started to circulate.

The barbarians of the Shugu Wandering Tribe were still dancing their bizarre dances, lost in their frenzied world.

After a moment, the squads of soldiers got into position, ready to ambush.

Suddenly, a sharp wail resounded from the Shugu Tribe’s camp, seemingly indicating that someone had detected danger.

This meant that there truly was a Golden Core leader within the Shugu Wandering Tribe.

Moreover, this person’s Divine Sense was quite keen.

He had sensed the ambush by the Danque Tribe.

But it was too late; as the wail rang out, Dan Zhu had already taken the lead and launched the charge.

The fiery red, lava-like Golden Core Power filled his entire being, emanating strong authority.

Fiery red flowing feathers encircled Dan Zhu, making him appear like the Vermilion Bird’s Saint Heir descending upon the world, inspiring awe.

Where Dan Zhu charged alone, the ordinary barbarian cultivators of the Shugu Tribe were no match, all burned to death with their meridians dried by Karmic Fire.

This was the first time Dan Zhu fully unleashed his Golden Core Power to charge into the enemy camp.

The soldiers of the Danque Tribe, seeing Dan Zhu’s bravery, his body flowing with fire, gorgeously bright red, couldn’t help but be filled with admiration.

Such a majestic and beautiful figure was their Young Master.

Their Young Master was leading the charge, burning the enemies of the Danque Tribe.

For Dan Zhu, they suddenly felt a strong sense of admiration and "loyalty", their hearts as if ignited by a fierce fire, boosting their morale greatly.

"Kill!"

Meanwhile, the two squads led by Ba Shan and Bachuan also converged, joining in the slaughter.

The soldiers of the Danque Tribe, filled with shared hatred for the enemy, raised their battle cries that tore through the night, shaking the mountains and forests.

The Shugu Wandering Tribe was thrown into disarray by the onslaught.

Yet, these tribesmen were already crazed and savage, circling around the bonfire, dancing their bizarre dances, their hearts dominated by madness.

After a moment of chaos, they disregarded life and death, shaking their heads and screaming like madmen, engaging in combat with the soldiers of the Danque Tribe.

But in front of Dan Zhu, these members of the Shugu Tribe were truly not opponents.

Such slaughter revealed signs of defeat.

At this moment, amidst the black mist, a figure painted with a white bone face paint and dreadlocks, looking somewhat sinister, emerged from the Shugu ranks.

This Golden Core cultivator seemed to be the leader of the Shugu Tribe.

His voice sharp and harsh, uttering something, he then wielded a magic treasure, a White Bone Staff, to summon various evil qi, attacking Dan Zhu.
